title: Molecular AOP Analyser: Key Event enrichment of gene-expression data against molecular Adverse Outcome Pathways

creators.name: Martens, Marvin
creators.affiliation: Department of Translational Genomics, Maastricht University

description:
A web application for Key Event enrichment analysis of gene-expression data in the context of molecular Adverse Outcome Pathways. Upload differential-expression results, or use a bundled demo dataset, and test them against Key Event gene sets.

Two enrichment methods are offered: Fisher's exact test (threshold-based over-representation, reporting both tails so depletion is a result rather than a null) and GSEA (threshold-free and direction-aware), both with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction. Results are presented as an interactive Cytoscape.js network of the AOP with per-Key-Event significance and gene-expression colouring, a ranked enrichment table, hub genes shared across Key Events, an embedded WikiPathways diagram, and PDF/HTML reports. A batch mode analyses up to ten datasets together and compares them across conditions.

This record archives the application source code, under GPL-2.0-only. The bundled data in data/ is third-party and separately licensed — see data/README.md. The Key Event to pathway mappings the analysis depends on are produced by the Molecular AOP Builder and published as their own citable dataset, 10.5281/zenodo.20184643; an enrichment result rests on that dataset as much as on this software.

A live instance runs at molaop-analyser.vhp4safety.nl.

Funding. Part of the VHP4Safety project, funded by the Dutch Research Council (NWO, ROR 04jsz6e67) under the Netherlands Research Agenda: Research on Routes by Consortia programme, grant NWA-ORC 1292.19.272.
